question.worked_solution:
Either the positive or negative of the expression inside the absolute value must be equal to the right-hand side of the equation.

So, we set up the two corresponding equations and solve them independently:

- If $|11-4x|=11-4x,$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}|11-4x| & =3 \\ 11-4x & =3 \\ -4x & =-8 \\ \frac{-4x}{-4} & =\frac{-8}{-4} \\ x & =2\end{aligned}
$$

- If $|11-4x|=-(11-4x),$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}|11-4x| & =3 \\ -(11-4x) & =3 \\ -11+4x & =3 \\ 4x & =14 \\ \frac{4x}{4} & =\frac{14}{4} \\ x & =\frac{7}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $x=2$ and $x=\frac{7}{2}.$
